title: Most Frequent Consecutive Number
scenario: Identify the number that has the highest 'streak' count (regardless of length). Return 'num'.
hint: Count how many islands exist for each number.
correctQuery: SELECT num FROM (SELECT num, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM (SELECT id, num, id - ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY num ORDER BY id)::INT AS grp FROM logs) t GROUP BY num, grp) t2 GROUP BY num ORDER BY SUM(cnt) DESC LIMIT 1;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE logs (id INT, num VARCHAR); INSERT INTO logs VALUES (1, '1'), (2, '1'), (4, '2'), (5, '2');
